steps.caption: The client list
steps.narration: This is Clients. Everyone you do business with is listed here, with their contact details.

steps.caption: Tabs: Job Won, Undecided, Declined
steps.narration: The tabs sort clients by where their bid stands: Job Won, Undecided, or Declined.

steps.caption: Search by name, email, phone or address
steps.narration: To find someone, type a name, an email, a phone number or an address. Let's look for Kane.

steps.caption: Open the client
steps.narration: Click the name to open the client's page.

steps.caption: Email, phone, address
steps.narration: At the top are the client's email, phone and address, with buttons to call or text.

steps.caption: Quick actions
steps.narration: Quick actions start the common jobs: schedule an appointment, write an estimate, add the client to your pipeline, or take a payment.

steps.caption: Payments: owed and collected
steps.narration: Below that, the page keeps everything about this client together. Payments shows what is still owed, and what you've collected.

steps.caption: Schedule: this client's visits
steps.narration: Schedule lists every visit you've booked for them.

steps.caption: Estimates, with status and opens
steps.narration: Estimates shows each bid with its status, and tells you when the client opened it.

steps.caption: Invoices
steps.narration: Invoices come next, each with a Record payment button.

steps.caption: Projects
steps.narration: Projects links to the job itself.

steps.caption: Messages with the client
steps.narration: Messages holds your conversation with the client, and you can reply right here.

steps.caption: Notes: team only
steps.narration: Notes are for your team only. The client never sees them.

steps.caption: See what the client sees
steps.narration: Back at the top, See what the client sees opens this client's portal the way they see it.

steps.caption: Menu: Clients
steps.narration: You'll find Clients in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to find a client and read their page | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of Clients in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will see how to search the client list, open a client, and find what their page keeps together: payments, appointments, estimates, invoices, projects, messages and private notes.
